info.name: Fountain Developer API (Hire API v2) Applicants API

description.content:
The Fountain Developer API lets customers of the Fountain high-volume hiring platform programmatically manage their hiring data - applicants, openings (funnels), positions, stages, labels, secure documents, interview scheduling slots, webhooks, and post-hire workers. All requests are authenticated with an API token passed in the X-ACCESS-TOKEN request header.
